A Garden Made for Gathering

An open-air events venue with a private garden, covered pavilion, and room for up to 100 guests — for weddings, debuts, and every celebration between.

Inquire About Your Date See the Garden

"Passing through the entrance, the venue feels like a whole different place."

That's the moment Miraya Garden is built around — the shift from the street outside to the quiet, green space within. Tucked in Dasmariñas, Cavite, it's a garden first: calm, cozy, and unhurried, with enough room to host a wedding, a debut, or a family celebration without ever feeling crowded.

The grounds hold both an open-air garden and a covered pavilion, so the celebration can move with the weather, not around it.

— a sentiment echoed across our guest reviews

What's included in the space

Every booking has the run of the garden and pavilion — here's what that means on the day.

Up to 100 guests
Capacity is kept close to 100 on purpose, so the party stays comfortable rather than packed — every review mentions how spacious it feels, even mid-celebration.
Garden & pavilion
An open-air garden for ceremonies and photos, plus a covered pavilion with a stage area for programs, speeches, and dancing once the sun goes down.
On-site parking
Guest parking on the grounds, sized for full-capacity events — no scrambling for street spots before the ceremony starts.
Evening ambiance
String lighting and greenery throughout make the space photograph well well after dark — several guests have called it their favorite backdrop of the night.
